subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Shell Companies and Fronts
description: A quick, practical guide to Shell Companies and Fronts.

hook.text: A laundromat in a quiet town generates $2 million in revenue. Nobody ever sees customers inside.

buildup.text: Front businesses mix dirty money with legitimate revenue. Cash-heavy businesses are perfect cover.

discovery.text: Shell companies exist only on paper. They have no employees, no offices, and no real operations.

twist.text: The Panama Papers revealed 214,000 shell companies hiding wealth for politicians and criminals worldwide.

climax.text: Shell companies thrive in secrecy jurisdictions where ownership records are hidden from regulators.

punchline.text: No employees. No office. Millions in revenue. Shell company.

quiz.question: What is a shell company?
options: A company that exists only on paper with no real operations
A startup in its early stages
